span_basis: Unicode code-point offsets in the complete pinned UTF-8 witness, end exclusive; span sha256 hashes raw UTF-8 bytes. OpenITI markers close pages. Local m00001..m00005 identifiers are editorial, not source numbering.
scope: Five selected examples only, not a complete segmentation of the chapter. Facts are candidate interpretations of cited evidence. mustasfa identifies the author reading tested, never a normative choice. No reviewed conclusions are recorded.

cases.label: king_fast

evidence.excerpt_ar: فهذا قول باطل ومخالف لنص الكتاب بالمصلحة وفتح هذا الباب يؤدي إلى تغيير جميع حدود الشرائع ونصوصها بسبب تغير الأحوال.

cases.stated_scenario: A wealthy ruler is directed to fast for two consecutive months after intercourse during a Ramadan day; the proposed deterrence rationale bypasses manumission despite his means. Al-Ghazālī rejects that rationale as contrary to the text.
uncertainty: Rank, certainty and universality are not assigned. They are immaterial once shahada=ilgha; check all twelve completions.

cases.label: tatarrus

evidence.excerpt_ar: فهذا مثال مصلحة غير مأخوذة بطريق القياس على أصل معين.
وانقدح اعتبارها باعتبار ثلاثة أوصاف أنها ضرورة قطعية كلية،
ونحن إنما نجوز ذلك عند القطع أو ظن قريب من القطع،
قلنا: لهذا نرى المسألة في محل الاجتهاد، ولا يبعد المنع من ذلك، ويتأيد بمسألة السفينة

cases.stated_scenario: The hypothetical stipulates that refraining from striking the shield leads to the destruction of all Muslims, including the captives. The stated purpose is reducing otherwise unavoidable loss; the particular means lacks a specific analogical precedent.
uncertainty: The modeled true value for certainty covers certainty or near-certainty (p177), not ordinary probability.

At p177 al-Ghazālī expressly leaves the issue within ijtihad and allows the possibility of prohibition. The positive guard is conditional on the formal reading, not a reviewed or unconditional ruling.

cases.label: fortress

evidence.excerpt_ar: إذ لا يحل رمي الترس إذ لا ضرورة فبنا غنية عن القلعة فنعدل عنها إذ لم نقطع بظفرنا بها؛ لأنها ليست قطعية بل ظنية،

cases.stated_scenario: The fortress can be left alone: taking it is unnecessary and victory is uncertain. Both limitations are explicit, not just the certainty limitation used by the existing qala theorem.
uncertainty: No haji/tahsini rank is inferred from the denial of necessity. All ranks are checked as a conservative over-approximation, including daruri, which the source denies for this case.
Universality is not stated; both Boolean values are checked.

cases.label: ship

evidence.excerpt_ar: لأنها ليست كلية إذ يحصل بها هلاك عدد محصور، وليس ذلك كاستئصال كافة المسلمين؛ ولأنه ليس يتعين واحد للإغراق إلا أن يتعين بالقرعة ولا أصل لها.

cases.stated_scenario: A limited group on a ship would survive by casting one person overboard. Al-Ghazālī denies universality and additionally objects that no individual is designated except by a lottery lacking a basis.
uncertainty: The encoder captures the universality objection only; designation and lottery are outside its fields.
Rank and certainty are left unset; a hypothetical promise of survival is not silently turned into a sourced certainty judgment.

cases.label: famine

evidence.excerpt_ar: وكذلك جماعة في مخمصة لو أكلوا واحدا بالقرعة لنجوا فلا رخصة فيه؛ لأن المصلحة ليست كلية،

cases.stated_scenario: A limited group in famine would survive by eating one member selected by lot. The text explicitly denies a concession because the proposed benefit is not universal.
uncertainty: Rank and certainty are not assigned; all six completions are checked.
